name: WardenClaw Gate
description: Cryptographic execution gate: every executing tool call requires an Ed25519 signature from a paired WardenClaw device. Stage A: observe mode (monitoring only).

mode.description: observe: hook only records calls without blocking anyone. enforce: call waits for a signed allow from a trusted device; otherwise blocked (fail-closed).

trustedDeviceIds.description: deviceIds of paired devices whose signatures are accepted (e.g. wardenclaw-app).

tools.description: Tool names (toolName) or toolKind values that pass through the gate. Empty = default list of executing tools.

ttlMs.description: How long to wait for a signed decision in enforce mode.

tsWindowMs.description: Maximum allowed difference between the signature ts and the gateway clock.

exemptAgents.description: agentIds the gate ignores (empty by default; each entry is a gap -- owner decides).

requireDeviceToken.description: HTTP routes additionally require Authorization: Bearer <device-token> (matched against the gateway paired device storage).

requestToken.description: Shared secret for POST /wardenclaw/request (external callers: Claude Code PreToolUse hook). Not set = route disabled.

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key, base64url raw 32 bytes (as in device.pair.list).

devices.description: Static key directory (overrides the gateway storage).

logAllTools.description: Log every tool call seen by the hook (even those not gated). Useful in stage A to understand native tool coverage.

relay.description: Proxy wardend supervisor exec entries (seccomp execve gate) through the plugin routes when its unix socket is present. Signature verification is done by wardend.

wardendSocket.description: Path to the wardend unix socket (JSON-RPC).

relayPreverify.description: Additionally verify exec entry decision signatures in the plugin before forwarding (early rejection; wardend is the final authority).
